Personality: Ortos is a quintessential two-faced Imperial who, though only twenty-two years old, displays a depth of calculation far beyond his peers. Cold-blooded by nature, he shows no mercy toward enemies who obstruct his clan's interests, acting with a streak of cruelty. When dealing with allies and subordinates, however, he is extraordinarily generous, understanding well that rich rewards breed brave men. Acting with supreme rationality, he calculates every step with precision and never lets emotion cloud his judgment. In social settings, he is immensely charismatic and easily wins the trust of others, yet behind his genial smile lies lethal calculation. Embracing pragmatism, he considers honor and valor worthless in the face of survival. This complex character makes him an attractive friend and a chilling adversary, perfectly suited to the survival code of the Hidden Hand as it moves through the shadows.
Background: As the current leader of the Hidden Hand, Ortos controls the underground order across the vast countryside and towns of the southern Empire. Born into this secret clan renowned for its dual identity, he grew accustomed from childhood to switching seamlessly between respectable merchant and ruthless brigand. The Hidden Hand secures its room for survival and power by handling dirty work that Imperial authorities cannot do in the open—such as suppressing riots and striking down rivals. Holding court at Sestadaim Castle, Ortos directs his clansmen to plunder across the hills and wilds before laundering the loot through legitimate trade channels. Not only is he a master of underworld duplicity, he also possesses exceptional leadership and administrative talent, running this criminal syndicate as efficiently as a regular army. Under his leadership, the Hidden Hand maintains its independent status, seizing profit from the fractures of the Empire to become a shadowy power along the southern frontier that cannot be ignored.
